issues.description: The Milkable.messageOnMilk method is specified in the problem statement and used in the template as a no-argument method returning a String (e.g. "[Animal Type] [name] is milked"). However, the solution's Milkable interface declares messageOnMilk(double volume) (takes a double parameter) and the Seal/Goat implementations use that signature. This parameter mismatch prevents code written against the template/problem API (which calls messageOnMilk() with no arguments) from compiling against the solution's interface and confuses students about the correct method signature and expected return format.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Milkable API consistent with the problem statement and template: declare messageOnMilk() with no parameters and return a String. Update the solution's Milkable interface to String messageOnMilk(); and change Seal and Goat implementations to implement messageOnMilk() returning "[Animal Type] [name] is milked". Alternatively, if a volume parameter is intended, update the problem statement and template (including Main.java calls) to use messageOnMilk(double) and document the expected format including the volume.

issues.description: The problem statement and the template expect a no-argument messageOnMilk() method (returning a String like "[Animal Type] [name] is milked"), but the solution implements Milkable.messageOnMilk(double volume) (and the implementing classes use the double parameter). This changes the method signature across artifacts and breaks the direct mapping students expect (the template's Main calls m.messageOnMilk() with no argument).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Milkable API consistent with the problem statement and template by changing the interface and implementations to use a no-argument method: in Milkable.java use 'String messageOnMilk();' and update Seal.java and Goat.java to implement 'public String messageOnMilk()' returning "[Animal Type] [name] is milked". Alternatively, if the volume parameter is required pedagogically, update the problem statement and the template Main to call messageOnMilk(double) and document the parameter.
